key_points.point: Dask Technology operates in the automotive SaaS space with multiple solutions
key_points.details: Daniel Aston (SVP Engineering, 6 years) and Alex English (SVP Product, 14 years) lead the Dask team which provides various SaaS solutions for automotive industry

key_points.point: Alex English has strong operational and product background
key_points.details: Previously led account management, support, onboarding, and deactivations teams before moving to product leadership 4 years ago

key_points.point: Mike Paylor is a long-term technology and product consultant
key_points.details: Working with Dask for 3 years, known them for 13 years; has VP Engineering and CTO experience at PayPal, Upwork, and startups; focused on infrastructure, DevOps, and cost savings

key_points.point: Conflict team consists of experienced engineers and data specialists
key_points.details: Luis Hernandez (30 years experience, distributed systems), Alicia (20+ years data engineering), Oscar (13+ years software development), Byron (8 years engineering), Hiram (full stack, e-commerce/cybersecurity background), Julio (8 years, full stack, DevOps to UI)

key_points.point: Leo is the project coordinator and leader
key_points.details: 20+ years in tech across ops, data, coding, AI, infrastructure; serving as central coordinator for the engagement

key_points.point: CDP (Customer Data Platform) implementation is the main initiative
key_points.details: Long-discussed project between Dask and Conflict teams; importance will become apparent through product breadth discussion

key_points.point: Meeting agenda focuses on purpose, objectives, and duration
key_points.details: 50 minutes available; Leo has hard stop for another meeting; includes overview, discussion, guiding questions, data sharing and access basics

key_points.point: Dask has developed data silos across multiple applications
key_points.details: Broad portfolio spanning media/advertisement services, lead response, and reputation management for car dealerships; need to consolidate sources of record beyond existing data lake and reporting engine

key_points.point: Scope alignment and goal definition needed
key_points.details: Need to hear from Dask on goals, what they're building, and requirements for success; common language and understanding essential for all participants

action_items.action: Schedule follow-up meeting(s) for deeper dive into CDP discovery
action_items.context: Leo has a hard stop at end of current meeting and indicated willingness to schedule subsequent meetings if needed to dive deeper into discovery

action_items.action: Provide overview and summary of CDP goals and scope to Conflict team
action_items.context: Leo requested Dan or Alex summarize what they're trying to build and the why to ensure common language and understanding across both teams

action_items.action: Cover data sharing and access requirements
action_items.context: Leo indicated this needs to be covered as it's necessary to complete the rest of the discovery process
